propositions: BindingRepository must own and persist live, retired, rotation, and alert files with byte-identical sorted, indented JSON and trailing newlines, performing no eager write on construction.
Rotation persistence failure must leave the sidecar old and live new with an inline floor retained, without raising, and a subsequent save must converge the sidecar from the retained floor.
Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open, return empty, preserve the file, and attempt best-effort deduped alerting.
Live persistence failure must leave live old, retain any earlier successful sidecar or retired write, clean temporary files, and raise an exception.
Retired and alert persistence failures must be handled distinctly: retired failure raises; alert failure is swallowed without altering the state-file result.
Unconditional save must attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, preserving the original corruption contract and partial-state failure order.
